svg.text: For a continuous variable, probability = area under the curve
The same density curve f(x) (total area 1) with four different questions.
P(X < a): area to the left
P(X > d): area to the right
P(X = b) = 0: a line has no width
Because a single value has zero area, P(X < a) = P(X ≤ a) for any continuous distribution.
